After a disastrous meeting with the deadly, enigmatic Orsted, Rudeus just barely manages to escape with his life. But there is light at the end of the tunnel, because he and his companions have at last reached their destination: Rudeus’s home, Fittoa. After a magical calamity flung its denizens around the world, what has become of Fittoa?

CAUGHT IN A QUAGMIRE

He finally gets the clue he’s been looking for from a friend of his old magic tutor, along with an unexpected invitation: a chance to attend the famous Ranoa University of Magic.

THE TRUE FACE OF SILENT FITZ

Rudeus enrolled at the Ranoa University of Magic to unravel the secrets of a magical calamity, but he keeps getting caught up in new kinds of trouble. Now he’s in the position to dish out some trouble of his own, with two animal-eared bullies at his mercy. Between being the new top dog on campus and experiencing some very confusing feelings for the charismatic Silent Fitz, Rudy’s school days aren’t easy!

“IF ONLY I COULD JUST START OVER AGAIN…”

Reborn into a world of swords and magic, Rudeus―a former 34-year-old deadbeat otaku―is determined to live his new life to the fullest, yet things take a surprise turn when Rudy is sent to stay with a faraway relative. In exchange for them teaching him sword fighting, Rudy agrees to tutor his second cousin. However, it turns out the only thing his new pupil is interested in is giving everyone a hard time!

ana.yazar: Yuka Fujikawa (Art By)Rifujin na Magonote (Story By)

Norn and Aisha reunites with Rudeus, who is living a happy newlywed life with Sylphiette, and they decide to welcome them to their new home. Rudeus is worried about Norn, who has entered the Ranoa Magic Academy and started living in the dormitory.

While Rudeus is spending a happy time with his wife Sylphiette and sisters Norn and Aisha in the Kingdom of Ranoa, he receives a letter informing him of the danger his father, Paul, and his companions are facing as they set out to rescue his mother Zenith. Then, an unexpected person reaches out to help the troubled Rudeus...?!

ana.ozet:
"Save Mother, even if it means dying!!"

Rudeus and Paul have finally found Zenith, and their fierce battle is over!! The trust and resolve passed on from father to son. The Teleportation Labyrinth Arc reaches its climax!!!

ana.ozet: I want to save the person I love. Just that and yet it’s so difficult. Unable to drink, unable to eat, unable even to walk, Rudeus is left with nothing but a crushing sense of helplessness.

ana.ozet: The head of the Greyrat family has a great responsibility to bear! Rudeus and Sylphiette finally welcome their long-awaited first child! As he spends time with his family as the household's pillar of support, Rudeus begins to desire even greater personal growth.

SKELETONS IN THE CLOSET

Having recently become tutor to the hot-headed young Eris, Rudy is elated to be deemed worthy by the eccentric side of his family. But the Boreas household seems to have more than a few dark secrets, and while the opportunities for knowledge and romance are tempting, there are some mysteries better left unsolved.

“ALL YOU HAVE TO DO.... IS TRUST ME”

Rudeus Greyrat’s new life takes a shocking turn when the country of Roa is overcome by a blinding light, leaving the fate of his family and friends unknown. He and his student Eris are transported to the Demon Continent, a foreign land which is strange even to Rudy.

“IT ISN’T OVER AS LONG AS I DON’T GIVE UP”

Rudeus, Roxy’s esteemed disciple, has disappeared along with most of the Fittoa Territory after a mysterious blinding light engulfed it. Now, Roxy’s journey to find him begins. Meanwhile, Rudeus “Rudy” Greyrat and Eris continue trying to find a way home, with the aid of those they’ve met in the Demon Continent, including Ruijerd, The Superd warrior.

WHAT THE FUTURE HOLDS

Magical calamity has sent Rudeus to the opposite end of the world! But the journey itself is not without its own excitement. On the way to his hometown, he comes to the aid of a rather scantily-clad young girl.

ana.yazar: Yuka Fujikawa (Art By) Rifujin na Magonote (Story By)
ana.ozet:
FAMILY REUNION

Rudeus has conquered the Demon Continent and traveled across half the world. Along the way, he’s made friends and bested enemies. Now, finally, their long adventure is nearing an end.

ana.ozet:
THE STAGE OF KINGS

The picture of grace, beloved of her people, Princess Ariel is nonetheless last in line for her throne…and caught in a deadly contest for the crown. There is but one person she can rely on: Her mysterious guardsman, Fitz, who hides a secret history!

ana.yazar: Yuka Fujikawa (Art By)Rifujin na Magonote (Story By)
ana.ozet:
A BROTHER DARES

After a magical disaster saw his family thrown all across the world, Rudeus is determined to bring them all back together. The next step just might involve storming a castle, and Rudeus isn’t about to back down from the challenge. But how will his half-sister Aisha feel about a reunion with a brother who never came for her–a brother she’s never met?

Rudeus was sent to the demon continent with Eris after a magical disaster. Can the two survive in this pinch of desperation with teamwork and guts ...!?

yan.ozet: Eris Boreas Greyrat is a former noble girl, who one day was transported to the other side of the world with her cousin Rudeus. She grew as a swordswoman, but ultimately was unable to save Rudy as he was nearly killed. Deciding that she wants to be someone who can support him rather than the other way around, Eris decides to leave Rudeus and go on her own journey.

Roxy's life is a lonely one-out of all her tribe, she's the only one without the power of telepathy. Her days pass in silence, while people speak words she can never hear. But when she saves the life of a wandering witch, Roxy gets the chance of a lifetime: the opportunity to study as a magician's apprentice, and leave her strange home behind!
Roxy heads to the labyrinth with Lene to make a new Staff. Roxy decides to make a suggestion to Lene, who is lacking in magic power for combat.

After graduating from Ranoa Magic Academy, Roxy heads to Asura Kingdom to find a job. However, she couldn't find any because of her appearance and being a demon. She eventually finds a job request that is looking for a magic tutor and heads to Buena Village.

The days Roxy spent with the Greyrat Family healed her troubled heart and became an experience that led to her own growth. Years pass, and when Rudeus reaches his 5th birthday, Roxy decides to give him a graduation exam.

THE ADVENTURING LIFE

Roxy and the rest of her party set out from Rikarisu in search of their grandest adventure yet. Dale dreams of unearthing the secrets within an uncharted labyrinth, but in a life of sword and sorcery, things rarely go as planned. Instead, Roxy's path takes an unexpected turn...and soon, the Guild hires her for a secret, undercover mission!

DEMON DAYS IN THE HOLY CITY

The humans of Millishion fear and distrust demonkin like Roxy–bad news for an adventurer hard up for work! Thankfully, after a chance meeting with another of her own kind, Roxy’s made some new connections. One of them is a mysterious, handsome magician… Could this be the beginnings of true love?!.

THE PRICE OF A SINGLE LIFE

Roxy continues her journey through the Central Continent with a quirky troubadour by her side, but confronts a harsh reality while saving a family from bandits: it’s sometimes necessary to kill to save others. Can Roxy overcome this crisis of confidence? And if she does make it all the way to the Kingdom of Asura, what will her old magic teacher think of her?

MAGIC SCHOOL’S IN SESSION

With her old teacher’s letter of introduction in hand, Roxy enrolls at the legendary Ranoa University of Magic. It’s a whole lot of firsts: Her first time in school! Her first time in a dorm!

Elementary, My Dear Roxy! Now that she’s all settled in at the Ranoa University of Magic, Roxy dives head-first into her studies. When one of the library’s tomes goes missing, Roxy takes it upon herself to track down a replacement copy.
The case of the stolen library books has been solved, but Roxy is still bewildered. One night, Roxie wakes up and notices something strange about Lanreta!

After several months of fulfilling requests, he begins to get used to Rosenburg, and suddenly receives sad news about Sara...!? A complete comic adaptation of Light Novel Volume 7 of the original novel, which depicts what happens after Rudeus breaks up with Eris!
